# ركائز للتطوير العقاري | Rakaez Developments

> Rakaez Developments (شركة ركائز للتطوير العقاري) is a premier real estate developer in Egypt, delivering high-end residential, commercial, and administrative projects across Bayt El Watan, New Damietta, and Mansoura.

## Main Navigation & Content

- [Homepage (العربية)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar): Main showcase of active projects, featured properties, and company milestones.
- [Homepage (English)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/en): English language homepage.
- [Projects (المشاريع)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar/projects): Catalogue of residential units, commercial spaces, and administrative offices.
- [About Rakaez (من نحن)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar/about): Corporate overview, vision, and architectural standards.
- [Blog & News (المدونة)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar/blog): Real estate investment guides, property updates, and market trends.
- [Services (خدماتنا)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar/services): Property development, construction management, and architectural design.
- [FAQ (الأسئلة الشائعة)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar/faq): Frequently asked questions about unit reservation and payment plans.
- [Contact Us (اتصل بنا)](https://www.rakaezdevelopment.com/ar/contact): Inquiry form, customer support hotline, and office coordinates.

## Key Information

- **Hotline**: 17074
- **Email**: info@rakaezdevelopment.com
- **Headquarters**: El-Beshbeshi & Abuelkheir St. Intersection, New Damietta, Egypt.
- **Specializations**: Luxury Residential Buildings, Commercial Malls, Administrative Offices.
- **Locations**: Bayt El Watan (بيت الوطن), New Damietta (دمياط الجديدة), Mansoura (المنصورة).
